scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "red,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
